title: Parent orchestrator default model
statement: The parent/current orchestrator shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 at medium thinking.

title: No xhigh default
statement: No Cartographer agent shall default to xhigh thinking. xhigh is never the default for any workflow step.

title: xhigh requires explicit approval
statement: Using xthinking level xhigh for any Cartographer workflow step shall require explicit human approval, recorded as a deterministic receipt with justification and approved_by.

title: Medium to high escalation guard
statement: Escalation from medium to high thinking for any Codex model shall require documented justification in a deterministic receipt, citing the specific quality gap or failure.

title: gpt-5.3-codex-spark text-only
statement: gpt-5.3-codex-spark shall not be used for vision/image tasks. It is text-only.

title: Drafting subagent model
statement: cartographer-drafter shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.3-codex-spark at medium thinking (or low for repeated polish loops). Fallback to openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini if Spark causes repeated rework.

title: Auditor subagent model
statement: cartographer-auditor shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 at medium thinking. High permitted for final gates, repeated validation drift, or complex contradictions. Fallback chain: gpt-5.4-mini then opencode/big-pickle (cross-provider requires approval).

title: Compass subagent model
statement: cartographer-compass shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 at medium thinking. High permitted for unresolved architecture, policy, or repeated failure decisions. Fallback: openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini.

title: Redactor subagent model
statement: cartographer-redactor shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 at medium thinking. Fallback: openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini. Cross-provider fallback not recommended for redactor.

title: Archivist subagent model
statement: cartographer-archivist shall default to openai-codex/gpt-5.4-mini at medium thinking. Escalate to gpt-5.5 medium for high-impact research. Fallback: opencode/big-pickle.

title: Subagent model config surface
statement: Subagent model, thinking, and fallbackModels shall be configurable via subagents.agentOverrides.<name> in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json. Supported fields: model, thinking, fallbackModels.

title: Parent auto-fallback on usage limit
statement: When a Cartographer workflow step using an openai-codex model fails with usage_limit_reached, the workflow wrapper shall detect the error, log a fallback receipt, and auto-retry with the next model in cartographer.parentFallbackModels. Capped to chain length.

title: Cross-provider guard
statement: Falling back from Codex subscription to API-key provider shall require explicit user approval. A --allow-cross-provider flag may pre-approve for CI. Receipt must include approved_by.

title: Fallback receipt schema
statement: Every fallback event shall produce a deterministic receipt with fields: failure_mode, from_model, to_model, reset_seconds, reset_secondary_seconds, approved_by, phase_id.

title: Parent fallback config key
statement: The parent orchestrator fallback chain shall be configurable via cartographer.parentFallbackModels array in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json.

title: Reset-time awareness
statement: The user shall be shown remaining cooldown time from Codex rate-limit headers during any fallback event. If reset is under 5 minutes, suggest waiting as alternative to cross-provider fallback.

title: Interactive config bootstrap workflow
statement: When Cartographer detects missing or partial model-routing configuration, the main agent shall invoke an interactive setup workflow/skill that lets the user choose providers, recommends role-specific models by cost/speed/thinking/context/modality/safety, recommends a main orchestrator model and thinking level, warns when fallbacks are missing, suggests available subscription/free models such as opencode/big-pickle as final fallback where appropriate, previews settings, validates with JSON Schema and available-model checks through a deterministic script, and asks confirmation before writing.

title: Auto-fallback within Codex
statement: Usage limit on gpt-5.5 triggers auto-retry with gpt-5.4-mini, no user prompt, receipt with approved_by:auto.

title: Cross-provider fallback with approval
statement: All Codex models exhausted -> prompt user for opencode/big-pickle with cost estimate. User approves or declines.

title: Subagent launch uses configured model
statement: User configures subagents.agentOverrides -> subagent uses configured model/fallbackModels, not parent default.

title: Auditor runs on recommended model
statement: cartographer-auditor configured for gpt-5.5 medium -> runs on that model.

title: Drafter runs on Spark
statement: cartographer-drafter configured for gpt-5.3-codex-spark -> runs on Spark at medium/low.

title: Fallback receipt recorded
statement: Fallback event -> receipt appended to receipts.jsonl conforming to REQ-14 schema.

title: Reset time displayed during fallback
statement: Usage limit error -> reset seconds displayed. Short cooldown suggests waiting.
